title: ReHoPER: Receding-Horizon Planning for Enhanced Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2610.00940v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We propose ReHoPER, an inference-only, zero-shot method that improves large language models' reasoning by generating and answering intermediate questions along multiple paths before the final answer. It iteratively plans a horizon of candidate intermediate questions, selects one to answer, and replans from the updated history. ReHoPER is task-agnostic, using the same generic instructions across datasets and models without labeled data or task-specific prompt design. Across multiple datasets, including iLLC, a new controlled benchmark for compositional reasoning, ReHoPER outperforms strong baselines, with the largest gains in the most compositional settings. Our implementation and the iLLC generator are publicly available to support future work.

translated_title: ReHoPER：基于滚动时域规划的增强推理方法
translated_abstract: 我们提出ReHoPER，一种仅推理、零样本的方法，通过在给出最终答案之前，沿多条路径生成并回答中间问题来提升大语言模型的推理能力。该方法迭代地规划一组候选中间问题，选择其中一个进行回答，并根据更新后的历史记录重新规划。ReHoPER与任务无关，在数据集和模型之间使用相同的通用指令，无需标注数据或针对特定任务的提示设计。在包括iLLC（一个新的组合推理受控基准）在内的多个数据集上，ReHoPER超越了强大的基线方法，并在最具组合性的设置中取得了最大的性能提升。我们的实现代码和iLLC生成器已公开发布，以支持未来的研究工作。
tldr: ReHoPER是一种仅推理、零样本的方法，通过迭代规划并回答中间问题来增强大语言模型的组合推理能力，无需任务特定提示设计即可在多个基准测试中超越强基线。
en_tdlr: ReHoPER is an inference-only, zero-shot method that enhances LLM reasoning by iteratively planning and answering intermediate questions along multiple paths, outperforming strong baselines without any task-specific prompt design.
